description: FREE SAMPLE - no auth or API key needed. Top 30 trending companies from Frontrun's follow graph over the last 7 days: name, X handle, sector, logo, follower count, first-flagged date, how many tracked accounts newly followed each, and up to four follower avatars as image URLs (counts and faces only - identities require a plan). Use this to try Frontrun before configuring a key.
name: trending_teaser
